20.name_native: The Book of Qiyam Al-Lail (The Night Prayer) and Voluntary Prayers During the Day

hadiths.text: It was narrated fom Ibn Umar that:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Witr is one rak'ah at the end of the night
